evidence_method: official-page browser review plus bounded GitHub Actions diagnostics

terms_review.conclusion: The reviewed official policies describe public browsing and downloading, monitoring, public-record disclosure, and general public-domain treatment. They prohibit unauthorized modification, security circumvention, and use outside intended purposes. No explicit authorization for recurring automated collection was found.
terms_review.functional_boundary: Use ordinary public browsing and official export surfaces only. Do not bypass access controls. Automated recurring execution remains blocked pending an approved access method.

automated_collection_diagnostics.finding: The original collector used brittle detail-page wording and rejected a valid CEQAnet detail shape. No repository mutation occurred.
The detail-page identity check passed, but robots.txt returned HTTP 406 under the collector request headers. No repository mutation occurred.
The CEQAnet entry endpoint returned HTTP 403 to the automated collector. No bypass was attempted and no repository mutation occurred.

access_assessment.automation_blocker: HTTP 403 observed during bounded automated collection
access_assessment.robots_conclusion: No positive permission conclusion is asserted because robots.txt was not reliably retrievable by the collector.

limitations: Browser-reviewed evidence does not include raw response bodies or body hashes.
